#### Calculate cluster markers of all clusters using wilcox.
```{r find cluster markers}

Idents(seurat) <- "RNA_snn_res.0.3"

table(seurat$condition, seurat$RNA_snn_res.0.3)

cl_markers <- FindAllMarkers(seurat, min.pct = 0.25, logfc.threshold = log(1.2))
  
top2_cl_markers <- cl_markers %>% group_by(cluster) %>% slice_max(n = 2, order_by = avg_log2FC)
top5_cl_markers <- cl_markers %>% group_by(cluster) %>%  slice_max(n = 5, order_by = avg_log2FC)
top10_cl_markers <- cl_markers %>% group_by(cluster) %>%  slice_max(n = 10, order_by = avg_log2FC)
top50_cl_markers <- cl_markers %>% group_by(cluster) %>%  slice_max(n = 50, order_by = avg_log2FC)

top_cl_markers <- cl_markers %>%
    group_by(cluster) %>%
     arrange(desc(avg_log2FC), .by_group = TRUE)

write.csv(top_cl_markers, "Plots/Protocol_optimization/top_cl_markers.csv")
write.csv(top50_cl_markers, "Plots/Protocol_optimization/top50_cl_markers.csv")

```

#### Calcualte condition markers of all clusters using wilcox.
```{r find condition markers}

Idents(seurat) <- "condition"

cond_markers <- FindAllMarkers(seurat, min.pct = 0.25, logfc.threshold = log(1.2))
  
top2_cond_markers <- cond_markers %>% group_by(cluster) %>% slice_max(n = 2, order_by = avg_log2FC)
top5_cond_markers <- cond_markers %>% group_by(cluster) %>%  slice_max(n = 5, order_by = avg_log2FC)
top10_cond_markers <- cond_markers %>% group_by(cluster) %>%  slice_max(n = 10, order_by = avg_log2FC)
top50_cond_markers <- cond_markers %>% group_by(cluster) %>%  slice_max(n = 50, order_by = avg_log2FC)

top_cond_markers <- cond_markers %>%
    group_by(cluster) %>%
     arrange(desc(avg_log2FC), .by_group = TRUE)

write.csv(top_cond_markers, "Plots/Protocol_optimization/top_cond_markers.csv")
```

```{r stacked violing plot function}

library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)

## remove the x-axis text and tick 
## plot.margin to adjust the white space between each plot.
## ... pass any arguments to VlnPlot in Seurat
modify_vlnplot<- function(obj, 
feature, 
pt.size = 0,
plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0, "cm"),
...) {
p<- VlnPlot(obj, features = feature, pt.size = pt.size, ... )+
ylab(feature) + 
theme(legend.position = "none",
plot.title= element_blank(),
axis.title.x = element_blank(),
axis.text.x = element_blank(), 
axis.ticks.x = element_blank(), 
axis.title.y = element_text(size = rel(1), angle = 0), 
axis.text.y = element_text(size = rel(1)), 
plot.margin = plot.margin ) 
return(p)
}


## extract the max value of the y axis
extract_max<- function(p){
  ymax<- max(ggplot_build(p)$layout$panel_scales_y[[1]]$range$range)
  return(ceiling(ymax))
}


## main function
StackedVlnPlot<- function(obj, features,
                          pt.size = 0, 
                          plot.margin = unit(c(-0.75, 0, -0.75, 0), "cm"),
                          ...) {
  
  plot_list<- purrr::map(features, function(x) modify_vlnplot(obj = obj,feature = x, ...))
  
  # Add back x-axis title to bottom plot. patchwork is going to support this?
  plot_list[[length(plot_list)]]<- plot_list[[length(plot_list)]] +
    theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1), 
          axis.ticks.x = element_line())
  
  # change the y-axis tick to only max value 
  ymaxs<- purrr::map_dbl(plot_list, extract_max)
  plot_list<- purrr::map2(plot_list, ymaxs, function(x,y) x + 
                            scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(y)) + 
                            expand_limits(y = y))
  
  p<- patchwork::wrap_plots(plotlist = plot_list, ncol = 1)
  return(p)
}

```

```{r stacked vln plot marker genes microglia per condition}
PrctCellExpringGene <- function(object, genes, group.by = "all"){
    if(group.by == "all"){
        prct = unlist(lapply(genes,calc_helper, object=object))
        result = data.frame(Markers = genes, Cell_proportion = prct)
        return(result)
    }

    else{        
        list = SplitObject(object, group.by)
        factors = names(list)

        results = lapply(list, PrctCellExpringGene, genes=genes)
        for(i in 1:length(factors)){
        results[[i]]$Feature = factors[i]
        }
        combined = do.call("rbind", results)
        return(combined)
    }
}

calc_helper <- function(object,genes){
    counts = object[['RNA']]@counts
    ncells = ncol(counts)
    if(genes %in% row.names(counts)){
    sum(counts[genes,]>0)/ncells
    }else{return(NA)}
}
```

#### Seurat-based label transfer
```{r Seurat-based label transfer}

seurat <- FindVariableFeatures(seurat)
seurat_MG <- FindVariableFeatures(seurat_MG)

# Perform Seurat label transfer for projection of the reference onto the query (iPSC-dervied) microglia
# Find anchors
anchors <- FindTransferAnchors(reference = seurat_MG, query = seurat, dims = 1:50, npcs = 50, reduction = "rpca", k.filter = NA,verbose = F)
# Transfer the categorical information across the two datasets as predict.id
# Seurat does not correct or modify the query expression data
# Label transfer based on timepoint
predictions <- TransferData(anchorset = anchors, query = seurat,refdata = as.character(seurat_MG$timepoint_wks), dims = 1:50, weight.reduction = "pca") # project the PCA structure of the reference onto the query by default (this can be changed with the weight.reduction parameter). TransferData returns a matrix with predicted IDs and prediction scores, which we can add to the query metadata.
seurat$timepoint_wks_transfer <- predictions$predicted.id


# Label transfer based on cell type
predictions <- TransferData(anchorset = anchors, query = seurat, refdata = as.character(seurat_MG$celltype), dims = 1:50, weight.reduction = "pca")
seurat$celltype_transfer <- predictions$predicted.id

# Order metadata levels
levels_primary_wks <- factor(c(9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 15, 16, 17, 18))
seurat_MG$timepoint_wks <- factor(seurat_MG$timepoint_wks, levels = levels_primary_wks)
seurat$timepoint_wks_transfer <- factor(seurat$timepoint_wks_transfer, levels = levels_primary_wks)

# Plot the label transfer by timepoint
pdf("Plots/Protocol_optimization/transfer_kracht_by_week.pdf",  width = 6, height = 5)
DimPlot(seurat, group.by="timepoint_wks_transfer", reduction="umap_css", pt.size = 0.6, cols = vintage_rich_cols(11)) & NoAxes()
dev.off()
png("Plots/Protocol_optimization/transfer_kracht_by_week.png",  width = 2700, height = 2600, res = 500)
DimPlot(seurat, group.by="timepoint_wks_transfer", reduction="umap_css", pt.size = 0.6, cols = vintage_rich_cols(11)) & NoAxes()
dev.off()


# Plot the label transfer by cell type
pdf("Plots/Protocol_optimization/transfer_kracht_by_celltype.pdf",  width = 7, height = 5)
DimPlot(seurat, group.by="celltype_transfer", reduction="umap_css", pt.size = 0.6, cols = col_primary_ct) & NoAxes()
dev.off()
png("Plots/Protocol_optimization/transfer_kracht_by_celltype.png",  width = 3200, height = 2600, res = 500)
DimPlot(seurat, group.by="celltype_transfer", reduction="umap_css", pt.size = 0.6, cols =  col_primary_ct) & NoAxes()
dev.off()

Idents(seurat) <- "celltype_transfer"
# susbet cells from each sample
hme <- WhichCells(seurat, idents = c("Homeostatic microglia (early)"))
hml <- WhichCells(seurat, idents = c("Homeostatic microglia (late)"))
am <- WhichCells(seurat, idents = c("Activated microglia"))

er <- WhichCells(seurat, idents = c("Erythrocyte"))

# plot each sample separately
png("Plots/Protocol_optimization/umap_by_celltype_transfer.png", width = 4500, height = 2600, res = 400)
(DimPlot(seurat, cells.highlight = hme,  reduction="umap_css", cols.highlight = c("#9A5C6B"), cols = "lightgray", order = T) & NoAxes() & NoLegend() |
```
